resources.string: Choose the original glass capsule, a docked Material bar, or either FinaSU-inspired floating form. Floating forms share the floating page header.
Floating glass with a selection highlight around the icon and label.
A full-width bar and matching header, with a compact icon indicator and the current theme colors.
Compact icon-only capsule with a selection indicator that slides between destinations.
The selected destination expands to show its label; other destinations remain icon-only.
